clips.title: The story
paras: At Southshore, Farren's Proof brings Lieutenant Farren Orinelle's report to Marshal Redpath. The murloc heads prove the work is done, though Farren will not carry them himself.

Lieutenant Farren Orinelle patrols and secures Hillsbrad Foothills' southern coast, but the brutal work of frontier warfare turns his stomach. After you cull the murlocs along the beaches, he cannot bring himself to touch the severed heads you bring back as proof. He sends you across Southshore to deliver them to the town's command.

Marshal Redpath oversees Southshore's defenses and military readiness as threats rise from Tarren Mill and wild beasts. He receives the sack of murloc heads from you instead of directly from Farren. Redpath knows you have become Farren's errand runner, but accepts the help. Southshore needs every willing hand to keep its borders safe.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You know, friend, I'd really rather not take these heads...
Since you've already got a handle on them, would you mind delivering them to Redpath for me?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings, citizen. Have you come to lend your arm to upholding the safety of Southshore?

clips.title: Completion
paras: If you assisted Farren in procuring these heads, then thank you. Southshore needs hard workers and effort to maintain its protection.
